entities.name: MBS services of interest
entities.description: The set of MBS services that the UE considers relevant based on specific conditions including reception method, session status, and FSAI inclusion.

entities.name: UE receiving or interested to receive via broadcast MRB
entities.description: Condition that the UE is either currently receiving or interested in receiving the MBS service via a broadcast MRB.

entities.name: Session ongoing or about to start
entities.description: Condition that the MBS service session is either currently ongoing or about to start, which may be determined from USD start and stop times.

entities.name: MBS FSAI in USD included in SIB21 from PCell
entities.description: Condition that one or more MBS FSAIs from the USD for the service are included in SIB21 acquired from the PCell for a frequency in the MBS frequencies of interest.

entities.name: MBS FSAI
entities.description: MBS Flow-Specific Assistance Information used to identify MBS services in system information.

entities.name: User Service Description
entities.description: Information element containing service details including start and stop times for MBS sessions.

entities.name: System Information Block 21
entities.description: System information block that contains MBS FSAI information for MBS frequencies of interest.

relations.description: MBS service inclusion is guarded by the condition that UE is receiving or interested to receive via broadcast MRB.
MBS service inclusion is guarded by the condition that the session is ongoing or about to start.
MBS service inclusion is guarded by the condition that MBS FSAI from USD is included in SIB21 from PCell.
The FSAI inclusion condition involves MBS FSAI identifiers from the USD.
The FSAI inclusion condition involves the User Service Description (USD) containing MBS FSAI.
The FSAI inclusion condition involves SIB21 which includes the MBS FSAI for MBS frequencies of interest.
The session status condition may use start and stop time information from the USD.
